minimumMissingObservableContract.onlyIfDeadVersionMechanismSelected: Then additionally require live/dead tuple support and the transaction/snapshot lifetime that may retain versions. sourceBackedRetention.facts: U builds a tree but transmits only node hashes absent from the previously bound current graph. SQL inserts into(store_id,generation,node_hash) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and validates duplicate payload identity. Nodes have stored payload/body/leaf_info/children/hash metadata. UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE are rejected by the immutable guard; no reclamation operation is present.
sourceBackedRetention.mechanism: Content-addressed graph delta and append-only rows
sourceBackedRetention.whatThisDoesNotProve: Actual total/unreachable rows, their physical bytes, whether an old node is referenced by a retained/pinned root or future proof, and avoidability are unmeasured. Identity sequence gaps/max are not inserted-row counts; ON CONFLICT may consume identity values.
sourceBackedRetention.whatThisProves: Retaining previous inserted graph nodes and reusing shared content is a deliberate source behavior. It is not a full-DAG rewrite for every CAS.

sourceBackedRetention.facts: Successful CAS updates one root-reference Store row in the same generation after guarded insertion; stale CAS returns before insertion. Restore returns nodesRetained:true and removes the graph root reference only through the original guarded restore path.
sourceBackedRetention.mechanism: Current root replacement and explicit retained historical nodes
sourceBackedRetention.whatThisDoesNotProve: An old root or node is dead/unused under all required proof/restore/concurrent-read contracts, or that MVCC versions constitute significant bloat. Current-source retention is not authority to delete original rows.
sourceBackedRetention.whatThisProves: Old immutable graph storage can outlive the newest root pointer; ordinary mutable Store updates can create MVCC versions.

sourceBackedRetention.facts: Usage rows are append-only and bound by generation/ordinal/previous/record/chain hashes. The actual matched reader verifies count, minordinal1, max=count and chain head, and aggregates all rows in the active generation. sourceBackedRetention.whatThisDoesNotProve: The on-disk byte cost of this ledger or the necessity of every unrelated generation/table row. Those require actual identity/size/root-liveness facts.
sourceBackedRetention.whatThisProves: Dropping old rows or retaining only a recent suffix would break this current proof/read contract.6000 is not a measured maximum lifetime policy or permission to purge older data.
